assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a production full-bleed cinematic ending keyframe for the Japanese anime game Refrain, landscape 16:9. Reference 1 (existing opening MINA illustration) is the exact character and line-art/style reference. Reference 2 (existing ending close-up) is the exact face and costume reference. Reference 3 is the location reference: a tall room of suspended empty glass window panes and a reflective floor, with a doorway toward a real sky. Draw the SAME MINA with very long SILVER-WHITE hair, clear blue eyes, white frilled maid headband, modest navy and white maid dress, dark collar ribbon and rectangular blue jewel. This is AFTER the boss battle, so use her usual silver hair and usual navy maid costume, never the black-haired boss form. Medium close-up, head and upper torso fully visible, character centered at 64% canvas width, face around y=35%, head safely 10% below top. Her hand is held gently against her chest; the other reaches tentatively toward a small warm rectangular reflection in the air to the left, as if an unanswered message has just reached her. Expression: vulnerable, exhausted, looking up with tears in her eyes, lips slightly parted, not smiling yet. The room is clearly visible, dusky cool blue-green glass with rose-gray and pale gold reflections, NOT a black void. The subject is lit clearly with readable skin, hair and clothing; no dim silhouette. Match the clean delicate anime contours, soft controlled cel painting and detailed but non-photoreal painted background of references. No realistic skin texture, 3D rendering, blur, bokeh, bloom blobs, UI panels, captions, lettering, borders or watermark. Keep bottom 24% calm and free of important facial/hand details for game subtitles. One coherent illustration, no collage and no walking.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the first image into the following emotional keyframe of the SAME ending shot. Preserve exact canvas size and full composition, camera angle, all suspended glass architecture, floor, MINA's identity, silver-white hair, blue eyes, headband and navy-white maid costume and jewel. No style change. The message has just reached her: lower her extended hand slightly and hold her palm open with a small soft warm reflection resting above it (a tiny rectangular glimmer, no text), her hand at her chest relaxes. Her eyes are wet with tears of relief, and she now has a small fragile closed-mouth smile, not a big grin. Warm sunrise light gently enters from the doorway, the cool room remains fully drawn and readable; warm highlights on her cheek, hair, hands and the glass. A hopeful emotional resolution rather than triumph. Keep head position and scale exactly stable to allow a gentle cross-dissolve between the two illustrations. Match the same fine anime line art and restrained soft cel-painting. No bloom obscuring faces, no bokeh blobs, no 3D, no photorealism, no lettering, logos, UI, borders or extra characters. Bottom 24% will carry game dialogue so do not move important details there.

Use case: illustration-story. Create one polished anime game ending CG for Refrain, landscape 16:9. A calm emotional reunion, four young women standing STILL together on the same rooftop from reference 1, now at sunrise, facing camera in a naturally spaced shallow arc. This is not a walk cycle. Medium-wide waist-up group composition: all four faces fully visible with comfortable gaps, no hugging, no overlapping limbs. Reference 1 is the rooftop/environment and group-order reference, reference 2 is MINA exact face/costume/style reference. References 3,4,5 are character identity references (story contact sheets, NOT a layout to copy): AKARI blonde bob gathered into a short low side ponytail, purple eyes, cream cardigan over white collared office shirt, blue lanyard; KOHARU shoulder-length straight brown hair and gold hairclip, amber eyes, navy school blazer white shirt purple ribbon; REI real-world form short dark-navy bob, purple eyes, gray hoodie over a pale shirt, no VTuber costume here. MINA long silver-white hair, blue eyes, frilled white headband, navy and white modest maid dress, dark bow with rectangular blue jewel. Four characters only, left to right AKARI, KOHARU, REI, MINA. Natural anime young-woman proportions matching the character reference sheets, NOT chibi. Akari smiles warmly toward Mina; Koharu has a shy relieved smile, hands gently holding a small closed notebook at her waist; Rei turns slightly toward Mina with a small sincere smile, one hand relaxed on the rooftop railing; Mina looks toward her three friends with tearful but peaceful eyes, hands lightly clasped near waist, relieved to be included. Faces around 32% down canvas, none cut off. Keep bottom 23% uncluttered for subtitles, no important hands there. Recognizable rooftop floor, low city skyline, peach sunrise under a pale blue sky with delicately drawn clouds; balanced cool and warm colors, crisp subject rendering. Match the clean fine anime linework, soft restrained cel shading and hand-painted background quality of reference 2 and the game story sheets. No photographic realism, no 3D, no chibi, no dark silhouettes, no bokeh or glowing blobs, no text or logos, no panels or collage. Not a generic posed promotional lineup: this is a quiet candid moment of acceptance among friends.
